biography.value:
Published alignment: N/LN.

Description

This juvenile wingless dragon has rocky scales with two large horns. Brown dragons usually live in caves or underground.

Defense

AC 23, touch 9, flat-footed 23 (+14 natural, -1 size)

hp 162 [228] (12d12+84)

mp 64

Fort +14, Ref +10, Will +15

DR 5/magic; Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Lightning 50%

Weakness Wind

Offense

Speed 60 ft., burrow 40 ft.

Melee Bite +20 (2d6+13), 2 Claws +20 (1d8+9), Gore +20 (1d8+13), Tail Slap +15 (1d8+13)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite & gore)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (80-ft. line, 6d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Earthquake, Eerie Howl, Sandstorm, Slow Breath (40-ft. cone, DC 21)

Special Abilities Triumphant Roar

Spells Known (FC CL 12th, Concentration +17)

At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 16) - pass without trace, stone fist

2nd (DC 17) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb

3rd (DC 18) - dispel, meld into stone, shifting sand, stone shape

4th (DC 19) - comet, spike stones

Statistics

Str 28, Dex 10, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 14

Base Atk +12; CMB +22; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +16, Climb +27, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (dungeoneering, local) +14, Perception +19, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth

Languages Draconic

SQ Earth glide

effect: Listed without text on brown dragon; use the same-age green dragon's Sandstorm, scaled to this dragon. Save halves both and negates 1d6 rounds of blindness.

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a brown dragon can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds (Reflex save DC 21 for half damage and negates the status effect). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
